GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) 3.15.0
Standard "No Charge" License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Free for commercial and non-commercial use as long as end users are not charged
a fee to use the product or to access any part of it. This site charges nobody
for anything, so it qualifies.

These files are vendored, not fetched. The published page makes zero network
requests to any host other than the one serving it, which is the same guarantee
the stylesheet and the fonts have. Refresh them with `npm run vendor`.
